info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Bromide Pendant Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Bromide Pendant Detail Management API enables users to add detailed specifications for bromide pendant products in the catalog. This endpoint supports creating comprehensive entries that include essential information such as dimensions, materials, and features. Retailers and catalog managers can utilize this API for efficient management of product details, streamlining the inventory process. It ensures high-quality data entry, enhancing user experience and operational efficiency in e-commerce platforms.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create new details for a bromide pendant. It accepts the necessary data in the request body to generate and store the details for future use.

requestBody.description: This request body allows the client to submit details for a Bromide Pendant. The provided data will be used to create or update the pendant information in the system.

200.description: Request processed successfully, returning the requested details.
